📌

Hey Product Hunt 👋 Ross (@ross\_jenkins) & Dani (@dani\_martin1), the owners of N8N Chat UI.  
  
The problem  
n8n is brilliant for building AI agents, but its built-in chat widget is basic. Making it look like your brand means digging into HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and your webhook URL sits in the page source for anyone to find.  
  
What we built  
A visual builder that turns any n8n workflow into a polished, on-brand chat widget. Customize it with a live preview, copy one snippet, and it's on your site. No code.  
Try the builder yourself, no signup needed: n8nchatui.com  
  
Key features

 Popup or in-page widgets, fully themed: colors, fonts, avatars, welcome messages, custom CSS [...] I connected Claude through the MCP server and asked it to match the widget to the client's branding. It set the colours, welcome message and starter prompts in one go, so I had something on-brand to look at straight away instead of a blank builder. Great time saver!

Good luck today!

If anyone else wants to try it, the MCP setup is in the docs at n8nchatui.com. Happy to answer questions here.
